archetype.description: A premium, authoritative, scholarly publishing house. Avoids generic SaaS aesthetics. Uses rich editorial typography, warm paper-like neutrals, and classic scholarly dark accents to establish trust and academic rigor.

typography.strategy: Old Money Tech / Editorial Future (Classic Serif Headings + Clean Sans Body)

rules: Use optical alignment: ensure text blocks align perfectly with the edges of images or containers.
Never center text by default unless in a narrow, specific hero layout. Left-align for editorial elegance.
Use asymmetrical bento layouts for the homepage featured categories (Mode A).
Use strict, dense grids for the book catalog (Mode B).
Images should never exceed 80vh on mobile.

surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glass - bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-[#0B1F2A]/10. Must remain highly readable.
surface_strategies.footer: Solid Dark - bg-[#0B1F2A] text-[#FDFBF7] py-24. High contrast.
surface_strategies.product_cards: Tactile flat cards. No heavy shadows by default. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow (shadow-xl shadow-[#0B1F2A]/5).

motion_and_interaction.page_load: Staggered fade-up for grid items using framer-motion (0.1s delay increments).

components.marketing_sections: Use raw HTML + Tailwind CSS (sections, divs) for asymmetrical editorial storytelling.
components.interactive_ui: Use highly customized Shadcn components (Accordion for filters, Select for sorting, Sheet for cart, Tabs for Book details).
components.icons: lucide-react (stroke-width 1.5 for a refined, premium look).

pages_to_build: Homepage (Hero, Categories Bento, Featured Bestsellers, Solutions/Services, Newsletter)
Book Catalog (Sidebar filters, Sorting, Product Grid, Pagination)
Book Detail Page (Cover showcase, Description, Author details, Meta specs table, Sticky Add to Cart)
Shopping Cart (Slide-out Sheet or dedicated page with mock checkout summary)

hero_backgrounds.description: Tall bookshelves filled with books in a grand library (use with dark overlay bg-[#0B1F2A]/60)
Abstract elegant composition of hardcover books stacked neatly

contextual_images.description: Young woman in a classroom reading a book

book_covers.description: Yellow book with drawing of woman's face

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute using kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='category-filter-school').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Cormorant Garamond and Manrope fonts. Ensure they are correctly loaded.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards for marketing sections. Build pure HTML/Tailwind asymmetrical bento layouts.
Use Shadcn only for complex interactions (Accordion, Select, Sheet).
For the Book Catalog, implement a Sidebar with filters (categories, grade, etc.) and a dense product grid.
The Hero Section should use the 'hero_abstract' or 'hero' image with a strict gradient overlay to ensure text contrast (WCAG AA).
In the Footer, use Grid Borders styling: stark technical look, exposing the grid skeleton.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms for automated testing.
